Based on the vacation itinerary for Hawaii (June 10-20, 2024), here are the essential items to pack:

- Sunscreen (essential for outdoor activities)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike)
- Casual outfits (for shopping, dining, and relaxation)
- Camera (to capture memories of the trip)
- Travel documents (passport, tickets, reservations)

- Snorkeling equipment (Hanauma Bay)
- Comfortable hiking shoes (Diamond Head)
- Light rain jacket (North Shore trip)
- Traditional attire (Luau experience)
- Waterproof bag (Kayaking at Kailua Beach)
- Comfortable walking shoes (Shopping at Ala Moana Center)
